signals.text: 5 open PM roles across 2 US offices
Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Own access and administration: SSO, role-based access control, admin tooling, user preferences, and system health. Make Revel easy to pass through a security review and easy for…
Set the strategy for our APIs and SDKs: what we expose, how we version it, and what we commit to supporting
Partner directly with platform engineering on the big architectural choices, and own the product side of multitenancy, scale, and reliability tradeoffs
Run discovery with customer administrators, IT and security teams, and our forward deployed engineers to find where operating Revel costs the most time today
Own the deployment and upgrade experience end to end, from connected installs to fully offline sites, so customer administrators and our field engineers can upgrade safely and…
Own the full workflow for writing, testing, deploying, and monitoring RevelCode: editing and deploying configurations to the runtime, unit testing control logic before it ships…
Own RevelCode usability end to end: syntax, snippets, completion, diagnostics, and the compiler errors customers report as the most confusing
Run discovery with customers and operators, including at air-gapped sites, to learn which editor features they actually depend on rather than which ones they’d claim to miss
Develop an IDE strategy that engineering agrees with. It should say what our IDE does better than a general-purpose editor for control programs, and what customers give up for…
Own an area of the platform or take a new product space from conception to launch
Develop the vision and strategic roadmap of a product area by identifying user needs, market opportunities, and competitive landscapes
Translate strategy into action by creating product requirement documents to align stakeholders, defining key milestones, and overseeing execution for the development team
Collaborate directly with the CEO, Head of Product, and Forward Deployed Engineers
Use the product the way customers do, work with real test data and hardware configurations yourself, and build your product judgement
Define the product vision and roadmap for hardware configuration and management, including addressing systems of increasing complexity as Revel breaks into new industries
Conduct deep discovery with test engineers and technical operators to understand how they configure channels today, where the friction is, and what a genuinely fast workflow looks…
Benchmark rigorously against best-in-class tools, and be explicit about where we need to match, and where we can be meaningfully better.
Partner closely with design and engineering to build a user experience that respects expert users rather than a simplified consumer-style interface that slows them down.
Translate discovery and benchmarking into clearly scoped requirements.
Work directly with early customers and beta users to conduct deep discovery — understanding their workflows, pain points, and mental models at a high level of fidelity.
Translate that feedback into clearly scoped product requirements, not just a list of feature requests.
Own roadmap planning for the simulation product and communicate priorities across engineering, design, and customer stakeholders.
Serve as the internal bridge between the simulation team and the broader Revel platform, ensuring sim integrates seamlessly into the overall product experience.
Partner closely with design and front-end engineering to craft an experience that feels modern and intuitive without sacrificing depth.
